text:
Alex (Sales): quick sync — ACME POC asks: 6 weeks, target 500 peak req/s, steady 200 req/s, avg prompt+response ~350 tokens, tail up to 4k tokens for doc loads. Need a capacity + SLA plan by EOD to finalize committed pricing.
Marta (Solutions): confirming: Dedicated reserved pool OK? any compliance constraints we should call out?
Alex (Sales): they want Dedicated (reserved) for predictability. SOC2 required and some datasets must stay in EU.
Deepak (Infra): quick calc: steady tokens/s = 200 * 350 = 70k tps; peak = 500 * 350 = 175k tps. On A100-80 w/ FP16 and decent batching we see ~40-60k tps per GPU for a 13B. So baseline reserved 3 GPUs covers steady (with KV cache), 4 gives headroom; autoscale burst to 8 for peaks. I'll mark the numbers conservative.
Jess (SRE): agree on min_replicas=3. Need cache warm-up to meet latency SLOs. Suggest canary 10% for 48h, pre-warm replicas for traffic cutover.
Sam (Eng): recommend mixed routing: short prompts (<128 tokens) -> 7B quantized nodes (cheap + low p95), long-context or heavy workloads -> 13B on A100. Cuts required reserved capacity by ~25% in our benchmarks.
Marta (Solutions): pricing ask: ACME wants a 12-month commit number for the reserved pool. For the POC (6 wks) they want a prorated reserved option. Thoughts?
Deepak (Infra): ballpark: 4x A100-80 reserved @ committed discount ~35% off list. For POC we can do a short-term trial reserved with prorated invoice and overage on bursts. I'll put detailed $s on the slide.
Alex (Sales): they're also asking about autoscale responsiveness and cold-start penalties — need exact wording for the contract.
Jess (SRE): scale behaviour notes: for Dedicated we can keep a warm-burst pool so scale-up <60s for adding warm replicas. Cold GPU spin-up (if no reserved burst) = minutes and model load adds ~800ms–3s p95 overhead on A100 with prefetch. We'll provide a latency curve image.
Sam (Eng): default autoscale policy we propose for POC:
```
policy: queued_requests
min_replicas: 3
max_replicas: 8
scale_up: +1 replica per 30s if queue > 20
scale_down: -1 replica per 5m if queue < 5
canary_traffic: 10% for 48h
cache_preload: true
```
Deepak (Infra): one ops note: enable prefix/KV caching for repeated system prompts — this can reduce compute by ~15–30% depending on repetition patterns. Strongly recommend for POC.
Marta (Solutions): security checklist: we need SOC2 answers + EU residency notes + KMS per-customer. @Jess can you draft short answers for Q3 (encryption at rest), Q7 (key lifecycle), Q12 (audit logging)?
Jess (SRE): I'll draft concise responses and attach redlines by EOD. For EU data residency we should propose eu-central deployment with a per-tenant KMS key.
Alex (Sales): customer asked whether we can guarantee p95 <250ms for short prompts (<128 tokens). Realistic?
Sam (Eng): yes on the 7B quantized path we push p95 ~80–150ms; 13B warm replicas also can hit <250ms for short prompts. Long-contexts will be higher. We'll include expected percentiles in the doc.
Deepak (Infra): gating: I can provision reserved pool and a warm-burst slot if procurement approves capacity reservation. If procurement delays, burst will be cold-start and slower.
Marta (Solutions): I'll schedule a 30-min call with ACME tomorrow to lock SLA wording and dataset handling.
Alex (Sales): action items:
- Deepak: 1-slide capacity + cost estimate (by 16:00 local)
- Sam: autoscale + routing config snippet + expected latencies (by EOD)
- Marta: security Q answers & EU deployment note (by EOD)
- Jess: confirm warm-burst behaviour and canary plan (by EOD)
Target POC kickoff Mon 2026-04-06. Can infra be ready by Thu (5 business days prior)?
Deepak (Infra): aiming to have reserved GPUs and warm-burst reservation ready; will flag any blockers if procurement or region capacity hit us.
Alex (Sales): perfect, thanks all :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy of canary config to staging at 2026-03-25T15:30Z (job #4821)
